name: cohortiq-routing-v1
description: Labelled routing questions for the adaptive router, on the two approved regulations in the project database ('SMVEC' 2023 for batches 2024-2025 'B-tech - CSE'; 'regulation 2' 2024 for batches 2022-2023 'b tech aids'). Labels follow the route definitions, not the router's output: general = answered by the cohort's regulations (even if retrieval ranks poorly); clause_lookup = cites a clause that exists for that cohort; low_evidence = about regulations but not answered by the cohort's approved regulations (including no applicable regulation and non-existent clauses); out_of_scope = not about academic regulations; clarify = cohort missing. Cases marked calibration were scored while choosing the threshold and vocabulary, so they are not held out.
